<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈ 178.0946 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 11 % of M) suggests about ten carbon atoms. A formula that matches this exact mass and the carbon count is C₉H₁₀N₂O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass = 178.0742 Da, within typical instrument error). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is:

C9H10N2O2

</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10N2O2</final_answer>
